about: Photo filters as film stocks: the Print model with per-filter tone, color and texture. Built by scripts/filmlooks.py; exported with scripts/print-look.py export-swift. Keys left out inherit from Print. grey = display luminance of 18% grey; slope = log-log contrast below the shoulder; shoulder = how hard highlights turn; white/floor = display white and black; printer/crossover = [red, blue] log-exposure offsets / gamma splits; interlayer = saturation; crosstalk = 0..1 of print-dye density coupling; grain = density std at 4032 px; shadow_tint/highlight_tint = split toning, offsets on the encoded print output weighted (1-Y)^2 / Y^2 (made luminance-neutral by filmlooks.py). Filters are tuned to stay far apart: nearest-neighbour mean ΔE (Oklab) >= 0.06 on the test images, vs ~0.05 median for Instagram-style CSS filters.
